# unifi_network_wan_sla (Resource)

A UniFi WAN failover SLA (health-monitor) profile (`wan-slas`, v2) — the probes and thresholds that decide whether a WAN is healthy, referenced by WAN load balancing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) SLA profile name.

### Optional

- `monitor_down_threshold` (Number) Consecutive failed probes before the WAN is considered down.
- `monitor_health_type` (String) How monitor results combine into health (controller-defined).
- `monitors` (Attributes List) Probes that make up this SLA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key — `terraform import` also accepts a friendly `name=<SLA name>` key.

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Optional:

- `domain` (String) Domain to resolve (for `dns` probes).
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between probes.
- `target` (String) Probe target (IP/host).
- `time_period` (Number) Evaluation window in seconds.
- `type` (String) Probe type: `icmp`, `dns`, or `speedLimit`.
